notes.title: Collectible cards have become available in Rabbit Hole.
notes.content:
We hasten to inform you that collectible cards, as well as badge, emoticons and backgrounds are now available in the Rabbit Hole game.

We also made a small update v 2.6
-Fixed a bug with changing mouse sensitivity.
- Improved anti-aliasing quality.
-Slightly optimized.

Have fun playing everyone and thank you for playing Rabbit Hole.

notes.title: Rabbit Hole 2.5
notes.content:
Hi all. We have published Rabbit Hole v2.5 update

The update contains:
-Improved graphics
-New anti-aliasing
-Added Turkish translation
-Improved optimization
-Fixed minor bugs that have been identified by players since the release of the game.

Thanks to everyone who bought Rabbit Hole. We will be very grateful if you share your opinion about the game with us.

notes.title: Rabbit Hole v 2.4
notes.content:
Dear friends,
the new Rabbit Hole update is ready. We follow your feedback
and very grateful for the advice. Thanks to those who bought Rabbit Hole and
supported this project. Now the discount for 14 days starts.
At the end of the sale, the price for a copy of the game will increase.

Update Information:
- Added additional save points.
-reduced AI detection range
-improved optimization
- fixed minor bugs

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39412747/a6d15e48b9b401352106dc45f7b2d6ee35e558cb.png[/img]

notes.title: Rabbit Hole game release
notes.content:
Dear friends. We are pleased to inform you that the Rabbit Hole game was released today. Now it is available on Steam. We thank those who supported us all this time and gave advice to improve the game. In the future, we plan to support the project and make updates to it. We'd love to hear your feedback and suggestions. It is very important to us. It helps us make games better. With love for games Blaze Games.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39412747/8fbdd57dbdb2a9f1852116a99a25beed9b41dfbd.png[/img]

notes.title: Rabbit Hole v2.0
notes.content:
Dear friends. We made a big game update before the releases. Now you can go through the game from start to finish, get all the achievements and enjoy the story. The game has undergone many changes and if you have saved data, we ask you to start the game again to avoid errors. With further updates, your saves will not be affected.

About update:
-optimal balance setting
-changed the behavior of monsters
-added new characters
-improvement of control and shooting
-added new languages
-added new location

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39412747/f64c0a48e457f6e7d1e7c0461a15dc04ea18dba1.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
Dear friends.
We are pleased to announce that the development of the game Rabbit Hole has already been completed.
It remains to settle small nuances with the preparation of the release and you will be able to pass it.
We have done a lot of work and hope you enjoy the game.

The game will be released on 10th of September 2022.

notes.title: Important news about Rabbit Hole!!!
notes.content:
Due to the current world situation, delays have occurred in some aspects of the game. The game on the technical side is at 90% completion. The final scene is already finished. The game will be out soon, but with a small delay. There is a sale right now, the price just before release will be higher. The first 2 scenes have also undergone changes. New characters have been added, the behavior of the monsters has been corrected.

Release date - July 2022.

notes.title: Rabbit Hole v1.2
notes.content:
We are constantly improving our project and in this update, thanks to the advice of the players, we have fixed some shortcomings.

In this update we made:
-Improved graphics, work with lighting.
-Reworked balance, added ammo, reduced monster chase time.
-Added hints for better navigation in large terrain.
-Fixed minor bugs.

From the bottom of our hearts we want to thank the players who help us with advice and participate in the development of the project.
